findings.title: Task 9 deletes predictTurret 'and its test cases' without naming the file that holds them
findings.claim: If `predictTurret` loses its only caller, Task 9 tells the executor to delete it and its test cases. The only tests for it are in tests/w4Online.test.ts, which is neither in Task 9's Files list nor in its Step 4 run, and `predictTurret` is not in the Step 4 grep.
findings.evidence: plan Task 9 'If `predictTurret` in `app/duel/weaponsSeat.ts` has no other caller (`grep -rn predictTurret src`), delete it and its test cases'; plan Task 9 Files: Modify `tests/crewHelmOnline.test.ts`, `tests/duelOnlineView.test.ts`, `tests/onlineDuelSession.test.ts`; tests/w4Online.test.ts:L10, L67, L78-82 import and call predictTurret; src grep: only onlineSource.ts:L20/L181 call it.
findings.why: An executor who follows only the listed files leaves w4Online.test.ts importing a deleted export. Task 9's own run passes, and the break first shows in Task 12's full suite.
findings.fix: Name the file: 'delete `predictTurret` and the `predictTurret` cases in tests/w4Online.test.ts (L60-83)'. Add tests/w4Online.test.ts to Task 9's Files list and its Step 4 run, and add `predictTurret` to the Step 4 grep.

findings.title: The rewritten lock test's stand part now passes trivially
findings.claim: With P read in Task 9, X's `stand` takes effect in P straight away, so the next E no longer runs at the Hound Weapons seat and sends no laserLock. `locks().at(-1)` is still room 2 from the new-round step, so the kept assertion passes whatever the stand does.
findings.evidence: plan Task 9 lock-test rewrite: 'The new-round and stand parts keep their assertions'; tests/onlineDuelSession.test.ts:L346-348 (X, then E, expect `locks().at(-1)` to be room 2, which L345 already left there); onlineDuel.ts:L309 (the lock branch needs `houndWeaponsSeat(d, me)`, and after Task 9 d is P).
findings.why: The stand step no longer tests anything. It does no harm, but it pins nothing.
findings.fix: Replace the stand part with `const n = locks().length; tapKey(r, 'KeyX'); r.pump(); e(); expect(locks()).toHaveLength(n);` (in P the seat has stood, so E sends no lock), or delete that part.
